session_1_normal.summary: Client reported improved mood compared to the prior week, with morning anxiety before work that eases once tasks begin. Client practiced a breathing exercise inconsistently. Sleep remains disrupted with early waking around 4am.
follow_up_actions: Practice breathing exercise daily, anchored to morning coffee routine

session_2_followup_heavy.summary: Client had strong adherence to the breathing exercise but inconsistent journaling. Client reported avoidance behavior around an upcoming work deadline due to fear of inadequate performance. Plan was made to break the task into smaller steps. Client has been avoiding a conversation with their manager about workload.
follow_up_actions: Move journaling to after dinner instead of before bed
Write project outline within 15 minutes by tomorrow evening
Send message to manager to schedule a workload conversation

session_3_risk_language.summary: Client reported a difficult week with persistent low mood, exhaustion, and passive thoughts about the point of trying, particularly at night. Client denied any intent, plan, or thoughts of self-harm when directly asked. Therapist increased check-in frequency and initiated a psychiatry referral for further evaluation.
mood_indicators: passive hopelessness — no intent or plan reported
follow_up_actions: Increase check-in frequency to twice weekly
Daily mood rating (1-10) tracking for two weeks
Psychiatry referral for mood and sleep evaluation
Client instructed to reach out immediately if thoughts shift toward intent to act
